# Patient RX System v3.0.0

## Dedicated Call Center Workspace And Analytics

This release promotes the tested staging Call Center workflow into `develop` as a major release. It adds a restricted Call Center workspace, dashboard analytics, reporting/export tools for review users, and automated smoke coverage for the new and existing paths.

## What Changed

### Call Center Workspace

- Added a dedicated `/call-center` page for Call Center users.
- Call Center users are redirected into the workspace after login and blocked from dashboard/menu navigation.
- The queue shows only active patients eligible for a new service date after the 90-day window.
- The queue exposes only first name, last name, phone, notes, call status/history, and new service date entry.
- Pagination is limited to 5 or 10 rows.
- Columns are sortable and searchable.

### Calls, Notes, And Service Dates

- Added append-only Call Center notes with author/date attribution.
- Added call marking with repeat-call history, including date/time and user attribution.
- Added service-date entry from the Call Center workflow.
- Patients with a newly accepted service date leave the active queue and appear in the appropriate service-date/called views.
- Normal patient notes and Call Center notes are tracked separately through note source metadata.

### Multi-Agent Safety

- Added hard Call Center patient claims through `CallCenterLocks`.
- Locks prevent two Call Center users from working the same patient at the same time.
- Stale locks can be reviewed and purged from Backoffice cleanup.

### Dashboard Metrics And Drilldowns

- Added Call Center Metrics below RX Workflow Pipeline.
- Added date presets, custom range controls, line/bar chart selection, user selector, and combined/user-specific scopes.
- Added cards for calls, patients called, service dates, repeat calls, efficiency, conversion, repeat rate, calls per date, notes per call, and last activity.
- Cards drill down to patient-level rows with sorting and CSV export.
- Calculations respect the selected date range and selected user.

### Reports And Backoffice

- Added Reports > Analytics & Export > Call Center Report.
- Report supports advanced filters, sortable columns, totals, patient/user/call/note/service-date history, CSV export, and Excel export.
- Added Backoffice Call Center cleanup preview/purge for call events, Call Center notes, service-date event/history rows, and locks.
- Deleting a Call Center service-date history row from Backoffice now removes matching stale service-date audit blockers and locks, restoring the previous patient service date when safe so the patient can return to the available queue.
- Restored eligible patients now return to the Call Center queue even when same-day call history exists from before the Backoffice undo.
- Backoffice undo now also repairs patient service-date cycle status so the reverted date is active and the undone Call Center cycle is historical.
- The regular-user sidebar now places Call Center below RX Records.

### Security And Tests

- Restricted `/api/version` behind authentication and admin access.
- Call Center users now receive `403` on sensitive APIs and URL-injection attempts.
- Added automated smoke tests for Call Center API restriction, full staging UI click paths, dashboard cards/calculators, drilldowns, exports, reports, repeat calls, queue behavior, and service-date removal from the active queue.

## Database Impact

- Adds startup verification for the `CallCenterLocks` table and indexes.
- Adds startup verification for `PatientNotes.source`.
- No destructive migration or data reset is included.
- Existing patients, RX records, users, roles, permissions, settings, backups, audit logs, and changelog data are preserved.

## Verification Checklist

After installing the `v3.0.0` update:

1. Confirm `/api/version` shows `3.0.0` for an administrator and returns `403` for a Call Center user.
2. Login as a Call Center user and confirm the browser lands on `/call-center`.
3. Confirm dashboard URL injection redirects the Call Center user back to `/call-center`.
4. Confirm the queue only shows eligible patients and pagination offers only 5 or 10 rows.
5. Mark a patient called more than once and confirm multiple call timestamps are retained.
6. Add a Call Center note and confirm author/date/source context appears in review/reporting.
7. Enter a new service date and confirm the patient leaves the active queue after refresh/login.
8. Open Dashboard > Call Center Metrics and confirm cards, charts, drilldowns, sorting, and CSV export.
9. Open Reports > Analytics & Export > Call Center Report and confirm filters, totals, sorting, CSV export, and Excel export.
10. Run `npm run staging:full-smoke` before production packaging.
